labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: Important but not blocking the current milestone.

milestones.title: v0.1.0 - .NET CLI Foundation
milestones.description: Create the initial .NET solution, CLI entry point, test setup, and reliable CI pipeline.

milestones.title: v0.2.0 - doctor Command MVP
milestones.description: Implement environment diagnostics for React Native CLI development.

milestones.title: v0.3.0 - create Command MVP
milestones.description: Create new React Native CLI projects with predictable validation and output.

milestones.title: v0.4.0 - basic-auth Template
milestones.description: Ship the first starter template for a common React Native application foundation.

milestones.title: v0.5.0 - Release Packaging
milestones.description: Prepare rn-fabricator for installation and public use as a .NET CLI tool.

issues.title: Create .NET 8 solution and project layout
issues.body:
Create `rn-fabricator.sln` with `src/Fabricator.Core`, `src/Fabricator.Cli`, and `tests/Fabricator.Tests`.

Acceptance criteria:
- Solution builds locally.
- Project references are configured.
- Folder layout matches the architecture documentation.

issues.title: Add System.CommandLine CLI shell
issues.body:
Add the first CLI entry point using System.CommandLine.

Acceptance criteria:
- `--help` works.
- `--version` works or has a clear placeholder.
- `doctor` and `create` command skeletons are registered.

issues.title: Add xUnit test project and first smoke tests
issues.body:
Add the initial xUnit test project and smoke tests for the CLI/core foundation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Test project references the required projects.
- At least one test runs successfully.
- Test naming and structure are documented by example.

issues.title: Make GitHub Actions run restore, build, and test
issues.body:
Update CI so it performs real .NET restore, build, and test checks after the solution exists.

Acceptance criteria:
- CI fails on build failures.
- CI fails on test failures.
- The workflow targets `main`, `develop`, and pull requests.

issues.title: Document local development workflow
issues.body:
Document how to restore, build, test, and run the CLI locally.

Acceptance criteria:
- README has local development commands.
- Required SDK/tool versions are listed.
- First-time contributor path is clear.

issues.title: Add external process runner abstraction
issues.body:
Wrap external command execution behind a testable abstraction.

Acceptance criteria:
- Core logic does not directly depend on `Process.Start`.
- Tests can simulate command success, failure, and missing executables.
- Exit code, stdout, and stderr are captured.

issues.title: Define dependency check result model
issues.body:
Define reusable models for environment dependency checks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Checks can return passed, warning, or failed.
- Results include dependency name, detected version, message, and remediation hint.
- Result model is covered by tests where useful.

issues.title: Implement Node.js, npm, and Git checks
issues.body:
Implement the first cross-platform dependency checks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Node.js version check works.
- npm version check works.
- Git version check works.
- Missing tools produce actionable messages.

issues.title: Implement Watchman, Xcode, and CocoaPods checks
issues.body:
Add iOS/macOS-oriented React Native dependency checks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Watchman check works where applicable.
- Xcode check is skipped or warned clearly on non-macOS systems.
- CocoaPods check reports actionable output.

issues.title: Implement Java and Android SDK checks
issues.body:
Add Android development dependency checks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Java check reports version or missing state.
- Android SDK detection checks common environment variables.
- Missing Android setup produces clear remediation hints.

issues.title: Render doctor command summary and exit codes
issues.body:
Render a readable `doctor` summary and map results to stable exit codes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Passed, warning, and failed checks are visually distinct in console output.
- Required failures return the documented environment failure exit code.
- Output is covered by tests where practical.

issues.title: Add project name and output path validation
issues.body:
Validate create command inputs before invoking React Native CLI.

Acceptance criteria:
- Invalid project names fail early.
- Existing output paths are handled safely.
- Error messages explain how to fix the input.

issues.title: Add React Native CLI project creation orchestration
issues.body:
Invoke React Native CLI project creation through the core orchestration layer.

Acceptance criteria:
- The command used to create the React Native project is explicit and testable.
- Failures are reported clearly.
- The implementation avoids hiding external process errors.

issues.title: Add safe file operation and rollback strategy
issues.body:
Design safe file operations for generated projects.

Acceptance criteria:
- Template application avoids silent overwrites.
- Partial failure behavior is documented.
- Rollback or cleanup strategy is implemented for critical failures.

issues.title: Print create command next steps
issues.body:
Print useful next steps after project creation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Output includes project path.
- Output includes install/run guidance.
- Output identifies generated example config files.

issues.title: Decide template packaging strategy
issues.body:
Choose how templates are stored and shipped with the CLI.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decision is recorded in `docs/decisions.md`.
- The chosen strategy works for local development and packaged tool usage.
- Tests can access template assets reliably.

issues.title: Add basic-auth template screens
issues.body:
Add Splash, Loading, Login, and Home screens for the first template.

Acceptance criteria:
- Generated files are readable React Native code.
- Screen names and folder structure are consistent.
- Template files do not include real secrets.

issues.title: Add simple auth flow wiring
issues.body:
Wire the basic-auth template into a simple authentication flow.

Acceptance criteria:
- Splash/loading/login/home flow is understandable.
- State handling is minimal and easy to replace.
- Generated code is documented by structure, not excessive comments.

issues.title: Generate environment and credential example files
issues.body:
Generate safe example config files for projects using the template.

Acceptance criteria:
- `.env.example` is generated.
- `credentials.example.json` is generated.
- Real secret files are documented as ignored.

issues.title: Add template application tests
issues.body:
Add tests that verify template application behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- Expected files are generated.
- Existing files are not silently overwritten.
- Example files contain placeholders only.

issues.title: Configure .NET tool packaging
issues.body:
Configure rn-fabricator for packaging as a .NET tool.

Acceptance criteria:
- Package metadata is present.
- Local tool installation can be tested.
- Package output is ignored or stored in the expected artifact location.

issues.title: Add installation and usage documentation
issues.body:
Document how users install and run rn-fabricator.

Acceptance criteria:
- README includes installation instructions.
- README includes doctor and create examples.
- Troubleshooting links are present.

issues.title: Add versioning and release notes workflow
issues.body:
Define the release versioning and changelog update workflow.

Acceptance criteria:
- Versioning policy is documented.
- CHANGELOG update expectations are clear.
- Release steps are repeatable.

issues.title: Prepare v0.5.0 GitHub release
issues.body:
Prepare the first public release candidate.

Acceptance criteria:
- CI passes.
- Release notes are complete.
- Artifacts or package instructions are attached to the release.
